content.description: Saturn is the #1 NFT Creation Platform On Cardano. Saturn leverages Multisig minting, in-app 10k file upload, customizable advanced whitelisting, and even a 4k automated image generator to create your NFT Project. Many NFT projects on Cardano struggle with their mint. The technology is complicated and many currently tools have routinely failed past mints or charge extremely high prices over 10% of the mint price. Saturn serves to solve all of these challenges at once.
